title: ひぐらしのなく頃に祭
title_romaji: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Matsuri

versions.note: A PS2 emulator names this build SLPM-66620-cda67466

sources: The harness alone, from the game's file (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written
Played from power-on: the first chapter's opening, 59 presses over four scenes
What the script said in play agreed with what each of 48 pictures had gained, over 4 scenes. 11 further screens were played and not read; no screen without text and no choice was among them
notes: Read by the script games/ps2/SLPM-66620.lua. The story's text is unpacked a page at a time to a fixed place, Shift-JIS with marks as single ASCII letters: k waits for a button, p ends the page, r starts a new row, v with digits, a slash, digits and a full stop names a voice. A word points just past the last mark the game has come to, in a second copy of the page: the script says each part when that word has passed it. Who speaks isn't shown by the game. Choices, menus and the tips aren't read.
